The 2017 critical local analysis does not imply the global quantifier or transverse asymptotic.

value.rationale: A global three-species convergence result on an eigenvalue -1 boundary addresses the natural 2017 Ricker global-attraction conjecture in a nontrivial symmetric slice. The exact tension between exponential compositional synchronization and provably algebraic radial transients is a meaningful dynamical mechanism, not a renamed local multiplier.
